lane_purpose: Large-storage / 8-GiB API-35 x86_64 4-KiB qualification lane for the managed-client import and measured playerbot tiers. Same system image, ABI, page size, and tag as AVD-Modern-x86_64-v1, but with 8 GiB RAM and a 30 GiB data partition so the full normal-play generation and 410-migration bot database fit. It is NOT equivalent to the 2.5-GiB / 10-GiB AVD-Modern-x86_64-v1 capability profile.

differences_from_avd_modern: RAM: 8192 MiB vs AVD-Modern 2048 MiB (guest mem_total 8137032 KiB vs 2532436 KiB)
data partition: 30 GiB vs AVD-Modern 10 GiB
purpose: large-storage lane required for the full import generation + bot database
relationship_to_other_lanes.not_a_substitute_for: AVD-Modern-x86_64-v1 25-bot qualification, which remains unproven on the smaller 2.5-GiB / 10-GiB profile

comparison.note: Allocatable storage (StorageManager vs df) and GL strings (app EGL vs host/emulator) are recorded separately during qualification runs. GL host GPU is the same NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5060 Ti used by AVD-Modern-x86_64-v1.
